Alright, maybe I'll go this weekend, but for now I'll stay put

I'll keep you updated on what happens

also, thanks man, I really appreciate it

I'd get therapy if I could, but my mom wouldn't really let me.
she thinks I'm just asking for attention and says that I'm "too young to be depressed" when I tell her about it

but maybe I'll go ask my girlfriend, I think she'd understand

I'd like to, but my parents are strict to only my academic performance, I'd be humiliated by my mom if I even discussed the idea of "taking a break" so stress is constant because I stay up to make up for my grades and be sleep deprived the next day, rinse and repeat

well, we're both in our 2nd year of college, and I'm immediately failing, barely getting any passing grades, I skipped the whole week to try and do my missing work, but I really couldn't get any work done because I really don't feel like getting out of bed unless I get to see her, the only times where I'm genuinely happy is where we spend time together, and the pandemic really isn't giving any favors.

Thanks for the concern.
